caption:
Most owners can tell you what they spend on ads.

Few can tell you what it actually returns.

The Ad ROI Calculator turns four numbers, monthly ad spend, lead count, close rate, and average job value, into three that matter: cost per lead, cost per booked job, and revenue per dollar spent.

Run it this month.

Fix whichever number is dragging worst, spend, close rate, or lead quality.

Run it again in 30 days and see which number moved.
